exposure: Timing of final intrauterine transfusion (IUT) (late: >=34 weeks, early: <34 weeks)
cohort: Pregnant individuals receiving intrauterine transfusions for fetal anemia at a single tertiary center between 2005 and 2024.
finding: Extending intrauterine transfusion (IUT) beyond 34 weeks in selected cases is safe and associated with improved obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The late IUT group showed reduced emergency cesarean rates (19% vs. 45%).
birth_weight: 2,350 g to 2,960 g (mean weights for early vs. late IUT groups)
gest_age: 34.1 weeks to 37.2 weeks (mean gestational age at delivery for early vs. late IUT groups)
